description:
Problem (Advisor finding F3): an oracle-verdict run started by an /oracle-review comment, a workflow_dispatch or the schedule completes against develop's head SHA. oracle-gate's bridge, which maps a completed run to the open develop pull request with that head, cannot map it. The gate then depends on the review-submitted notification or on the hourly sweep. The notification runs the pull request's own oracle-review.yml, which the pull request can delete or alter. The verdict job already knows the pull request number.

Outcome: after oracle-verdict posts its review and status, its post job dispatches oracle-gate.yml on develop for that pull request number.

Decision gates (stop and report if one fails):
1. Proceed if oracle-gate-cutover-live-verification-20261025 recorded that a comment, dispatch or schedule verdict completion did not map to the pull request, or recorded the path as not observable. Notification suppression by the pull request is an independent reason to proceed. Drop with evidence only if the completion mapped and the owner accepts relying on a PR-controlled notification.
2. oracle-review-notify-only-20261025 removed actions: write from the post job. Re-add only that permission, and record why, if it is needed to dispatch.
3. The test asserting that no workflow other than oracle-gate.yml posts the oracle-gate context must keep passing. Dispatching is not posting; extend the test to tell them apart instead of weakening it.

Item guardrails: dispatch only after the review is persisted, and only for pull requests whose base is develop. oracle-verdict never posts the oracle-gate status. Verdict logic, reviewer selection and the bridge job are unchanged.

Common guardrails: work only in a linked worktree created by make worktree-create, after make agent-write-preflight; the primary clone is read-only. No SKIP or --no-verify, no stand-in approvals, no ruleset edits or bypasses, no raw gh pr merge. Close out with make pr-preflight, make pr-open, oracle SHIP on the exact head, then make pr-arm. Do not change oracle-gate's App binding (integration 5201041), the oracle decision rule, or the native review-thread-resolution requirement. Do not close and reopen, mass-rerun or rebase other pull requests. No explanatory comments or docstrings (COMMENT-POLICY-001). Every behavior change gets a test that fails on the previous code.
